text: Remove the assumption that a complete schematic is the starting point: review an incomplete design through explicit engineering obligations.
rationale: Track missing operating conditions, load cases and component limits as unresolved obligations that prevent affected conclusions from becoming passes.

text: Remove the assumption that the baseline is correct: independently audit whether the requirements can coexist.
rationale: Produce contradiction witnesses and feasibility bounds while preserving the frozen baseline; proposed requirement changes remain separate owner decisions.
trap: A general feasibility solver would imply physical completeness; bound any contradiction witness to declared arithmetic constraints.

text: Remove the assumption that a repair means changing the board: generate operating restrictions, assembly options and component substitutions as repair candidates.
rationale: Subject each alternative to the same required invariants and independent review, with explicit limits on where the repaired system can operate.
trap: Operating restrictions cannot silently relax the frozen requirements; requires a separate owner-authorized baseline.

text: Remove the assumption that engineering review ends with a verdict: produce a minimal experiment that distinguishes competing explanations.
rationale: Turn unresolved findings into bench procedures specifying stimulus, probe placement, expected observations and the decision each result supports.

text: Remove the assumption that reviewers receive one authoritative interpretation: require competing circuit interpretations where connectivity or intent is ambiguous.
rationale: Expose conclusions that depend on disputed assumptions and identify the smallest clarification or measurement that resolves them.

text: Remove the assumption that a physical model must already exist: let users supply qualified behavioral contracts for unfamiliar devices and assemblies.
rationale: Contracts declare supported conditions, uncertainty and validation evidence, enabling bounded review of connectors, cables, batteries and modules without claiming universal simulation.

text: Give each review an immune memory of previously escaped defects that triggers targeted checks when a related circuit pattern reappears.
rationale: Adaptive immunity becomes a versioned library of defect signatures, with explicit applicability conditions and evidence required to clear each trigger.

text: Treat repair proposals like transplanted tissue: check the interfaces for rejection before accepting local improvement.
rationale: Transplant compatibility becomes a repair contract covering power domains, grounding, timing, thermal paths, mechanical fit, and required topology.

text: Use quorum sensing to distinguish independent reviewer agreement from several reviewers repeating the same unsupported assumption.
rationale: Cell signaling becomes an agreement map that records evidence ancestry and shared dependencies before adjudication counts corroboration.
trap: Corroboration scores cannot become voting authority or expose peer judgments to initial reviewers.

text: Build a gut flora of narrow engineering specialists that activate when the candidate contains their preferred circuit habitat.
rationale: An ecological community becomes qualified review modules for subjects such as connector abuse, startup sequencing, analog settling, and manufacturing tolerances.

text: Give bench calibration a biological metabolism that tracks how evidence ages as instruments, fixtures, firmware, and operating conditions change.
rationale: Metabolism becomes a provenance and applicability lifecycle that requests renewed measurements when the conditions supporting an envelope change.

text: Run repair campaigns through a developmental checkpoint sequence that tests whether the circuit can reach its intended operating state.
rationale: Embryonic checkpoints become staged reviews of power application, reset release, initialization, steady operation, fault entry, and recovery, with qualified evidence at each transition.

text: Route unresolved findings through discipline-specific queues with explicit entry criteria and named resolution owners.
rationale: Queue manifests carry candidate hashes, evidence gaps, and blocking dependencies between circuit, layout, simulation, and bench work.

text: Batch bench measurements by fixture setup, then bind each result back to its individual candidate and requirement.
rationale: A shared instrument setup serves multiple review requests while per-sample manifests preserve calibration, identity, and provenance.
trap: Multi-board instrument scheduling precedes a proven single-board acquisition path; defer batching.

text: Dispatch just-in-time evidence requests when an adjudication decision reaches a specific unresolved engineering question.
rationale: Each request specifies the measurement, operating conditions, required uncertainty, and decision it will unlock.

text: Use qualified specialist analysis tools as spokes around a central evidence intake hub.
rationale: Each spoke declares its supported domain and returns results through a common manifest with applicability limits and parser checks.

text: Give rejected repairs a returns process with a reason code, reproducible failure package, and explicit disposition.
rationale: Returned candidates retain their evidence and route to revision, baseline restoration, or owner clarification without losing the failure history.

text: Treat the owner's physical board as the last-mile delivery destination for every accepted repair.
rationale: A candidate-bound handoff includes component substitutions, rework sequence, inspection points, and acceptance measurements tied to the reviewed revision.
trap: Automatic rework instructions need board-specific physical safety validation beyond this software project.

text: Seal each review stage as a resumable transaction with an explicit crash-recovery policy.
rationale: A killed KiCad process or host reboot resumes from verified artifacts without repeating repairs or mixing candidate generations.

text: Make every stalled run emit a self-contained incident capsule with inputs, tool versions, process state, bounded logs, and a replay command.
rationale: The next engineer can reproduce the failure without reconstructing an ephemeral workspace or collecting diagnostics from the owner.

text: Introduce an explicit inconclusive outcome that identifies missing evidence and the exact engineering claims it prevents.
rationale: Unavailable simulators, unsupported models, and unqualified bench samples stop producing ambiguous failures that demand manual interpretation.
trap: A new inconclusive enum alone duplicates existing incomplete outcomes; useful only with structured obligation semantics.

text: Fence repair agents with expiring write authority tied to one candidate generation and revoke it before independent review begins.
rationale: A delayed or orphaned repair process cannot mutate the design beneath reviewers or contaminate a later campaign.

text: Provide a recovery console that explains the blocked stage and offers validated resume, evidence recollection, or candidate abandonment actions.
rationale: Owners can resolve routine operational failures while preserving immutable baselines and required topology.

text: Turn resolved incidents into a fault-injection corpus covering hung producers, truncated reports, disk exhaustion, stale artifacts, and interrupted bench ingestion.
rationale: Release checks exercise recovery behavior and verify that infrastructure failures cannot become engineering approvals.

text: Require each repair to carry a claim-by-claim proof of preserved requirements, with unresolved claims blocking acceptance.
rationale: A clean native check or reviewer verdict does not establish that the repaired circuit still satisfies its intended operating conditions.

text: Make refusal a structured engineering result that identifies the missing evidence, affected decisions, and exact conditions for resuming review.
rationale: Unsupported thermal, isolation, stability, or fault claims need actionable boundaries that survive adjudication and campaign retries.

text: Trace bench conclusions through specimen identity, board revision, firmware, instrument configuration, calibration status, and raw captures.
rationale: Measurements support a candidate only when their relationship to that candidate and their acquisition conditions can be established.

text: Give every model and measurement parser a qualification envelope that automatically withdraws its authority outside validated conditions.
rationale: A pinned tool can execute reproducibly while producing conclusions outside its demonstrated physical or interpretive validity.

text: Attach explicit evidence invalidation rules to component substitutions, layout changes, requirement edits, and manufacturing variants.
rationale: Previously accepted evidence can become inapplicable after a small change, even when historical margins appear unchanged.

text: Produce a reproducible acceptance dossier that exposes shared reviewer dependencies, dissent, adjudication overrides, and residual uncertainty.
rationale: Independent review must be inspectable for common assumptions, and a downstream engineer must be able to reconstruct why acceptance was granted.
